The clause reflects only the default 4-week entitlement under s 87(1)(a) but omits the 5-week shiftworker entitlement under s 87(1)(b). Section 87(1) of the *Fair Work Act 2009 (Cth)* (snapshot 2026-07-07) provides:

(b) 5 weeks of paid annual leave, if: (i) a modern award applies to the employee and defines or describes the employee as a shiftworker for the purposes of the National Employment Standards …"

The clause guarantees only 4 weeks. An employee who qualifies as a shiftworker under s 87(1)(b) is entitled to 5 weeks. The clause does not accommodate that entitlement.
